remarks: Nestled on a peaceful 1.12-acre lot along a quiet South Wilton street, this property offers the perfect balance of privacy and convenience. Surrounded by mature trees and natural beauty, the setting provides a serene retreat while still being just minutes from everything Wilton has to offer.  Ideally located with easy access to shopping, restaurants, schools, parks, and major commuting routes, this home combines a tranquil lifestyle with everyday convenience. Whether you're enjoying the expansive yard, entertaining outdoors, or simply appreciating the peaceful surroundings, this is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy the best of South Wilton living.
